system.description: With a little effort, you can shed parts of your body. When one of your appendages is restrained or grappled, you may burn a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait to tear it off and wriggle away. You may do this for as much blood and Willpower as you're willing to sacrifice. While missing a limb, gain the Negative Trait Lame (with no extra Trait granted for it). Roleplay the deformity until the limb regrows.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter One ("Legends and History"), "Merits and Flaws"
